steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: The deed is still not done?

steps.name: Malicious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: There was some serious kung fu on both sides, so we had no chance to strike.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Leave that young Candleholder to his own devices, he won't affect our plans.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: But the woman from Lungmen was never accounted for, and she's still after us.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: What a pain.

steps.name: Malicious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: We'll keep an eye on things, and make a move when the time is right.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: No, after these two clashes, the mandarins will definitely be on alert, so we have to be more cautious.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: I can let the woman live for another two days, but our organization can leave no clues.

steps.name: Malicious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Right... Then what do we do now?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Just wait. It won't be long before he gives us fresh orders.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: 'The mounts, seas, and all in between shall be our master's.'

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: They've stolen the land without even knowing it... the people will pay for their arrogance.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Soon.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: And who might you be waiting for?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Attempted assassination of a court official and disturbing the people's peace. Your conduct befouls the laws of Great Yan. It's like they mean nothing to you.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: You have two options.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Lay down your arms and come with me. Or I bring you in.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: You were followed.

steps.name: Malicious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: It's the same man from before.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: He turned the tables on you. Considering his skill, it's no surprise you couldn't do anything about it.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: But in the end, it was still you who led this man here, do you understand?

steps.name: Malicious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Good. Now, we'll get rid of him first, and then decide how to deal with you.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: You dare?!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Late as it is, you're still awake?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: We must be vigilant, lest something like yesterday's incident happen again.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Surely the Grandmaster has not invited me out so late to enjoy the scenery?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: It's auspicious for Lord Wei to stand here with us at such a crucial moment. Indeed, it would have been best to take a stroll through the city of Yumen and enjoy its scenery.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The Lord Exorcist's decision naturally comes after careful consideration.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Perhaps this is not for me to say, but the Lord Exorcist's responsibilities reach far beyond the safety and security of Yumen.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The consequences of just one mishap are grave enough that the word 'trust' no longer carries much weight.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Indeed, it is so. General Zuo and I have worked together for decades, without relying on 'trust'.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I hope you understand.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Have I ever expressed any dissatisfaction?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Speaking of which, we have yet to properly catch up on each other's affairs.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The last time I came to Yumen was five years ago, and the time before that was ten, but both were hectic visits.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: And our last meeting, let me think... we were in the capital.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Yes, the year you left the capital, I had happened to be there to report on my work.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I didn't expect you to remember something from so long ago.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Do you not remember it, Lord Wei?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I don't recall what year it was, exactly, but my memories tell me it was also spring then.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Late spring. A little later than the current season.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: That's it.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: At the time, you still wielded a sword... And you were not yet called 'Wei.'

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: There was much scenery to enjoy, and plenty of kung fu spectacles too. I have lived for so long, there are not many who leave a true impression.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: But even now, as I evaluate the various styles of kung fu, I still think about Chi Xiao's ultimate move.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I'm honored to win such a praise from the Grandmaster of kung fu.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: That night seemed like it was set to rain, the weather stifling, the clouds looming low.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I was on the keep, and far away, but even then I saw a light in the direction of the posthouse.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The sky abruptly broke with the chill of a sword. A sharp and decisive style of swordsmanship.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: 'As sword of stratus rent, once stood stand fast.'

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Afterwards, Lord Wei must have left the city. In the end, the rain did not fall.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: It was a very long time ago.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But I wonder why you're bringing this up?
The tower stands high, the two men's clothes rustle in the breeze.
Even though it is a windless night.
As far as the eye can see, Yumen's sentries and buildings stretch on without end. Only through the wind on the highest of points can one clearly perceive that the city is moving at a high speed.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: There is treachery in the court, and minds can be unpredictable. Surely, no one understands this better than you.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: But I also believe that whose mind is consumed by ambition and cunning could never wield that style of swordsmanship.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: There is a matter that I would like you to help with.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I dare not refuse a request from the Grandmaster himself.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I would ask you to trust Yumen, just this once.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You and the Lord Exorcist are alike, shouldering the peace of Yan. There are many matters of concern... but in the end, Yumen is unlike Lungmen.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Yumen was built on strength of arms, and most of the people here practice kung fu. These people have great passion, but lack strategic thinking.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Regardless, everyone here acts for the country and its people, and there is nothing wrong with hating evil as an enemy.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I only fear that simple-minded people will be manipulated without their knowing.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: General Zuo has agreed to a time limit of three days. Within these three days, you will get your answer.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Until then, I hope you will set your grievances with the Lord Exorcist aside, and stay your hand.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: A guest must comply with his host, and the Lord Exorcist has asked me to wait in these barracks at ease. I simply wished to share his burden, but there is really nothing I can do.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I recall, that Envoy Lin of Lungmen from a few days past is indeed shrewd and capable, solving several cases cleanly in just a few days' work.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I imagine there must be several talents like her in your employ.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...You might be overthinking the situation.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Whether the Grand Tutor, the Lord Exorcist, or Wei Yenwu, every move is calculated for the safety of the people and prosperity of the country.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: There should be no conflict between us.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: But looking back over the few millennia... there have been those who shared a goal, but a number of them inevitably break and even turn against each other, yes?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Indeed, you are most qualified to speak of this.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Very well, for your sake... I will agree to your request.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You have my thanks, Lord Wei.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The night is no longer young, I suggest you retire.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Oh, but... there is another thing, I think I have yet to mention.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: 'Cloud-splitting sword' is not actually Chi Xiao's ultimate move.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: (repressed gasping)

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Now, you still hold the option to surrender. Choose that option, or you will never stand again.

steps.name: Malicious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: (Anguished groaning)

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Right now it is merely at your waist, move again and the dirt will bury you up to your shoulders.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Three more of you lie in hiding in the alley on the left, and two more in the eaves on the right.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Your actions were to draw out my weakness and create an opportunity for an ambush.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: But you will not get such a chance.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: I admit, I've underestimated your strength.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: It's rare... for one to be proficient in both kung fu and Originium Arts.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: You are unworthy to comment on my kung fu.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Yesterday, Envoy Lin of the L.G.D. fended off an attack while returning to the city, and was followed today with errant intent. Earlier, a Sui Regulator Candleholder met with an assassin in the city center, these acts were most probably all your doing, correct?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: To intercept and kill a Catastrophe Messenger, to steal Catastrophe data, just what are the Shanhaizhong planning in Yumen?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Who exactly is behind you?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: You'd better check who's behind you first!

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: What—

steps.name: Malicious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Thank... thank you very much for saving my life...

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: I'm sorry for all that.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss?
steps.text: You shouldn't be wasting your time here.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: The Lungmenite woman investigated the warehouse at the Sword Forge. She's making a lot of trouble...

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: If you're so worried about trouble, why not go directly to the only variable that can sway the whole situation?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: The old man at the Sword Forge.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Go find him, and let the Catastrophe data disappear along with his body.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Master, look out—

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: You shouldn't be able to stand.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Rest... go...
The ground suddenly sinks beneath them, as if charged with vitality. The raised earth and rocks surround everyone in an instant.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Master, this man is not to be underestimated—
A cold light flashes for just a moment.
A man falls to the ground, earth and rock unmoving.
The block is dead silent.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Waste of time, and boring beyond comprehension.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Yühsia, what took you so long?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I happened to meet an acquaintance, so I took the chance to say hello.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: You're a Lungmenite, and yet you seem to know plenty of people in Yumen...

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Well, that's enough talking. Let's piece together the information we gathered and see if we can figure anything out.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I didn't get to finish that conversation on the street, what progress have you made on your end?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Miss Du, what kind of person owns the Sword Forge?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: You mean Uncle Meng?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: He's an old friend of my father's, from when he was still in the business. His kung fu is renowned, but he's good at talking too, and every martial artist in Yumen trusts him.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I'm not familiar with Yumen, so Xingyu Logistics being able to operate here is all thanks to him.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Does this stuff have anything to do with Uncle Meng?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Just wondering.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: If you have something to say, get to the point already!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I've had a suspicion that this band of thieves causing chaos in the city stowed away with the supplies smuggled from Lungmen.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I've been on the smugglers' trail and it led me to the Sword Forge's warehouse.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: So? What did you find?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The warehouse had only iron billets and forge fuel. All the materials you would need for a forge.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What was strange was the warehouse guard.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: He had an unusual sunburn around his neck. Looked like a mark from wearing special protective equipment.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: As I understand it, the Catastrophe Survey Teams dispatched by the Imperial Astronomical Bureau trek through the desert for long periods of time, and they wear a standardized mask for protection against the wind and sun.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: That sunburn wasn't faded. And the Imperial Astronomical Bureau has only dispatched that one team lately.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: So you're saying there's something suspicious about the team, and that they're connected to Uncle Meng?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'm trying to get us on the same page with the facts I've found.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Yumen has just returned from the depths of the desert, where the sunlight can be intense, and sunburns are common among the city residents.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Is that one little thing all you've got to make you suspicious?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Do you recognize this object?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: (voice shaking) Where did you find this?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The warehouse.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I found it lying in a corner. It seemed unique, and was standing out from the piles of iron billets and fuel.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: This is a 'Xingyu Logistics' armband that I designed myself.
The red armband is inlaid with gold trim, as well as a Shangshu-style embroidery of twin lines flowing through a pattern of five-pointed stars, symbolizing auspicious and smooth trade routes.
The signifiers of luck and peace are dyed a disturbing ochre-red, and the stains of yellow sand make it look mottled and old.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Only the kids who followed me to Yumen from Shangshu would have this. Did the Qis also...?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: If what befell the Messenger team happened outside Yumen, then this shouldn't have made it into the city at all!

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Are the Qis still alive?! If they are, then why are they hiding? No, who's holding them and keeping them from showing themselves?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Uncle Meng? But doesn't he have four men he knows on the team.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Miss Du, let's not jump to conclusions just yet. We need to calmly analyze the...

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: If I can't figure it out, then I might as well stop thinking. I'll just head to the Sword Forge and get my answer!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Miss Du!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Yühsia.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I saw a tourist dressed like a Lungmenite downstairs earlier, probably one of your men?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: He came to pass you something, right?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: That armband was evidence brought back from where the Messenger team was intercepted and killed outside the city.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You're using Miss Du.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: We have a lot of clues pointing us towards the Sword Forge right now, so we need to probe it a little.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: If the man is innocent, then we've ruled out a decent possibility, and she will also feel at ease.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: If there's really something up with the Sword Forge, won't you have put her in danger?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: She's certainly not the only one in danger here in Yumen.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Yühsia, I know you have your responsibilities, and maybe this is how you've always done things.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I'm not about to argue with you over what's right or wrong, but I can't agree with your approach.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I have to go help her.

steps.name: Yumen Sentry
steps.text: Lord Zuo.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What happened?!
The tall Forte lies on the hospital bed, his visage pale. He's barely still breathing.
In Zuo Le's memories, Taihe was always like a mountain.
This mountain stood beside his father and himself, unshakeable.
What sort of force could break this mountain? Zuo Le has never considered such a possibility.

steps.name: Yumen Sentry
steps.text: Monitor Censor Taihe was brought to a military camp by two civilians not long ago...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Tell me his condition first!

steps.name: Yumen Sentry
steps.text: T-The medics say they've managed to save his life... but perhaps only his life...

steps.name: Yumen Sentry
steps.text: Monitor Censor Taihe has suffered multiple external injuries, but what's more serious is the damage to his organs. He has suffered massive internal bleeding. If he were an ordinary man, I'm afraid he would have already...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Uncle Taihe shouldn't have been involved in this, he was helping me under the table...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Where is Father?

steps.name: Yumen Sentry
steps.text: The General is guarding the outer city tower.

steps.name: Yumen Sentry
steps.text: I've also notified the General, and there were only four words in his reply.

steps.name: Yumen Sentry
steps.text: 'Stay at your post.'

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Where are the ones who brought Uncle Taihe here?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Tell me the truth.

steps.name: Nervous Passerby
steps.text: We just saw the Forte dressed in mandarin clothes lying by the roadside. We have no idea what happened, but we figured we should bring him over here...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The city is under high alert right now. What were you doing out so late at night?

steps.name: Nervous Passerby
steps.text: We had trouble sleeping, so we went out for a walk... who would've thought there would be someone lying by the roadside as soon as we went out? Terrifying.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: So you live in the area, but heard nothing strange?

steps.name: Nervous Passerby
steps.text: Nothing...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Where did you find the wounded?

steps.name: Nervous Passerby
steps.text: In the south of the city, near the Sword Forge's alley!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Sword Forge...

steps.name: Nervous Passerby
steps.text: Sorry... Can I can go home now?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Your testimony is unclear, so as a witness, you can't leave just yet.

steps.name: Nervous Passerby
steps.text: Ah, w-well...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Millenion.

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: Present.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm moving out. Gather your team.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Search the Sword Forge.

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: Sir... The General's orders were to stick to our posts.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Father ordered me to hunt down the assassin and locate the sword in three days to restore peace in Yumen. Even with his strength, Monitor Censor Taihe has been gravely injured. This surely has some link to the Feranmut followers.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Going to the scene of the crime to find the truth and arrest the culprit, is that not sticking to my post?!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Go.

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: Yes, sir.
